decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to quickly assemble the Mystic Forge combo using artifact ramp and tutors like Karn, the Great Creator. With cards that generate mana and untap artifacts, the deck aims to utilize Mystic Forge's ability to cast artifacts from the top of the library to generate a powerful board state or win condition. The inclusion of specific artifacts like Basalt Monolith, Voltaic Key, and Candelabra of Tawnos allows for exponential mana generation, leading to explosive turns and potentially overwhelming the opponent with card advantage and efficient threats.

The main concept of this Reanimator deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with high-powered creatures using cards like Entomb and Thoughtseize, then reanimate them onto the battlefield with spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead. The deck features countermagic with cards like Daze and Force of Will to protect your combo pieces, along with card selection and draw spells like Brainstorm and Ponder to find the pieces you need. With powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with big threats early in the game.

The deck focuses on controlling the board using land destruction and disruptive spells while setting up the combo of Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage to create a 20/20 Marit Lage token. It utilizes cards like Life from the Loam and Exploration to fill the graveyard and enable land recursion, while also using Mox Diamond for ramp. The inclusion of cards like Crop Rotation and Expedition Map helps to find key lands quickly, making the deck highly versatile and adaptable in various matchups. The goal is to outvalue and outlast the opponent through resource denial and powerful land interactions.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures and then reanimating them for a strong board presence. The key strategy is to use cards like Entomb and Reanimate to put high-impact creatures like Archon of Cruelty or Atraxa, Grand Unifier into play early in the game. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect the combo. This deck aims to outpace and overpower opponents through a combination of graveyard manipulation and efficient, game-ending threats.

This BUG Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan while gaining card advantage through various spells and creatures. The deck utilizes a mix of removal spells, counterspells, and card draw to control the board and outvalue the opponent. With strong threats like Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath and Murktide Regent, this deck can quickly close out the game once it has gained control. Additionally, the deck includes some land disruption with Wasteland and versatile creatures like Endurance to handle graveyard strategies.

The main concept of this Dimir Tempo deck is to control the game by disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Thoughtseize and Daze while applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Barrowgoyf and Nethergoyf. Utilizing counterspells like Force of Will and removal spells like Fatal Push to maintain board control, the deck aims to outpace the opponent and turn the tide of the game in its favor. With a focus on tempo and disruption, this deck seeks to establish early dominance and close out the game quickly.

The main strategy of this deck is to control the game through land-based disruption while utilizing powerful control and removal cards. It focuses on quickly finding key lands like Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage to create a powerful combo, while also utilizing cards like Life from the Loam to recur important lands and disrupt opponents' strategies. The deck aims to grind out opponents through a mix of land destruction, creature removal, and efficient control cards like Pithing Needle and Grafdigger's Cage. It also utilizes Mox Diamond and Once Upon a Time to ramp up quickly and execute its game plan effectively.

This deck focuses on quickly and efficiently milling through your entire library and winning the game with cards like Thassa's Oracle or Dread Return before your opponent has a chance to respond. The deck is designed to use a combination of fast mana sources, discard spells, and creature-based combo pieces to execute its gameplan as quickly as possible. By utilizing unique cards like Balustrade Spy and Undercity Informer, this deck aims to win the game in a single explosive turn, catching opponents off guard with its all-in strategy.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with key creatures using cards like Entomb and Brainstorm, then bring them back into play with Reanimate and Animate Dead to overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats. The deck also includes disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect the combo pieces, as well as utility creatures like Brazen Borrower and Tamiyo to provide additional value. Additionally, Wasteland is included to disrupt the opponent's mana base and slow down their game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to assemble the Nomads en-Kor and Nadu, Winged Wisdom combo, which allows the player to draw their entire deck and win the game. The deck includes protection spells like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares, as well as card selection tools like Brainstorm and Ponder to find the combo pieces. It also includes utility creatures like Dryad Arbor and Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath to help stabilize the board and gain value. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up its win condition.

The focus of this deck is to quickly assemble and execute a game-winning combo using a combination of fast mana acceleration, creature sacrificing, and graveyard recursion. By casting a series of efficient spells and creatures, the goal is to mill the entire library into the graveyard and then use Thassa's Oracle to win the game instantly. The deck is designed to be all-in on the combo, with minimal interaction with the opponent's board state and a heavy reliance on precise sequencing and timing to achieve victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing efficient creatures and disruptive spells to apply early pressure and disrupt opponents' strategies. It utilizes cards like Thoughtseize and Snuff Out to disrupt opponents' hands, while also using cards like Green Sun's Zenith and Once Upon a Time to efficiently find key creatures. The deck also includes cards like Grist, the Hunger Tide and Endurance to provide additional threats and disruption. The mana base is designed to support the aggressive game plan while also providing flexibility with cards like Gaea's Cradle and Wasteland.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly assemble an artifact-based engine that generates a large amount of mana and card advantage, allowing the player to cast multiple spells in a single turn and ultimately win the game through either Aetherflux Reservoir or attacking with powerful creatures like Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Thundertrap Trainer. The deck aims to be proactive and apply early pressure while also having the ability to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Force of Will and Sink into Stupor.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty, then bringing them back onto the battlefield with cards like Animate Dead and Reanimate. By utilizing cards like Entomb and Brainstorm to set up combos, and disruption cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect the strategy, the deck can overwhelm the opponent with early threats. The inclusion of cards like Brazen Borrower and Murktide Regent provide additional versatility and disruption options to ensure the combo can go off smoothly.

The deck focuses on building up mana quickly with cards like Dark Ritual, Lion's Eye Diamond, and Lotus Petal to fuel powerful combo spells like Tendrils of Agony and Ad Nauseam. The deck also utilizes cards like Wishclaw Talisman and Burning Wish to tutor for key combo pieces. The goal is to generate a large storm count by casting multiple spells in one turn, then finish off the opponent with a lethal Tendrils of Agony or Necrodominance. The deck also includes disruption in the form of discard spells like Thoughtseize and Duress to protect the combo.

The deck aims to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Thoughtseize, then use Reanimate and Animate Dead to bring them back into play for a powerful combo. It also utilizes control elements like Force of Will and Daze to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck's win condition is to overwhelm the opponent with the powerful reanimated creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Murktide Regent, ultimately leading to victory through sheer card advantage and board presence.
